en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: Amr bin Hamama Doosi He is also a long lived human being, who lived for 400 years. Following is his own composition:

I have become aged and my age is so prolonged as if I have been stung by snake that is not yet dead. Thus death did not destroy me and I was not destroyed? But years of spring and summer passed on me. I have definitely left behind three hundred years and I hope to live for four hundred years.
